name: agent-verification-kit
description: Evidence-required completion for agentic coding, enforced by hooks rather than by instructions. Blocks a commit unless a fresh verification stamp exists; the stamp is earned only by a passing test or build command, scoped to the repository being committed to, expiring after 30 minutes, and cleared by any file edit. Refuses to modify an existing test or test config without a declaration naming the path. Clears that stamp when a test command FAILS, via PostToolUseFailure - the event Claude Code actually fires for a failing tool call, which this kit did not subscribe to until 0.5.0. That handler has been observed clearing a real stamp after a real failing suite; it does not fire for chained commands, wrapper flags, or a suite whose failure is swallowed by || true, and a failure behind a redirect or a cd into a directory that does not exist clears the stamp without being recorded as a flake, because no suite ran; before that a commit could be permitted after a red suite (INC-0025) and flake triage could not fire (INC-0024). Marks a suite that passed only on a re-run as flaky and refuses that commit unless the flake is declared and carried in a Flaky: trailer. Also refuses a commit whose agent definitions name a model that does not resolve. Governs this harness only, and can be walked around by narrowing the test command — see README for what that does and does not cover.
